thread:
Emma Carter: FYI customer ACME-Health (BC-9123) opened a billing dispute — invoice shows ~4.3k more tokens than dashboard for 2026-02-18 midnight rollup.
Jordan Lee: Ack — can you paste their invoice lines and dashboard snapshot? ticket INC-4567 created.
Emma Carter: Sent privately. Quick summary: dashboard shows 1.2M tokens, invoice counts 1.24M. They flagged tokens at 00:00-01:00 UTC.
Billing Bot: ALERT: nightly-rollup job detected 3,200 duplicate ingest events for customer acme-health at 2026-02-18T00:00:00Z.
Liam Patel: Putting on my debug hat. Possible duplicate webhook retries or job overlap during shard migration. Will check ingest logs.
Sophie Nguyen: Finance will need a provisional credit line and a revrec note if we confirm double counting. Please label the case with "provisional_credit".
Jordan Lee: Found matching duplicate event ids in logs. Looks like idempotency_key was empty for ~7m during the deploy window.
Emma Carter: Oh — that matches a deploy at 23:59 UTC. Support Ops said the deploy rolled the batcher without draining.
Support Ops Bot: Deploy 2026-02-18T23:59:01 started by @devops. Rolling restart: batcher-service v2.14.3 -> v2.15.0.
Liam Patel: Snippet from ingest logs:
```
2026-02-18T00:00:03Z INFO event_receive id=null customer=acme-health token_count=320
2026-02-18T00:00:04Z INFO event_receive id=null customer=acme-health token_count=320
2026-02-18T00:00:04Z WARN duplicate_detect disabled shard=5
```
Jordan Lee: SQL to confirm dups (ran against ledger-prod):
```
SELECT event_hash, count(*) as c, sum(token_count) as tokens
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-health' AND created_at >= '2026-02-18' AND created_at < '2026-02-19'
GROUP BY event_hash
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Liam Patel: Query returns 3,200 duplicate rows totaling 4,320 token overcount (matches invoice delta). Root cause: idempotency not enforced during batcher restart window.
Sophie Nguyen: OK finance ask: provisional credit of $4320 token-equivalent (USD converted on invoice) and a revrec memo referencing INC-4567 + BC-9123. Assign to me for signoff.
Emma Carter: Notifying customer: "We've identified duplicate ingest for midnight rollup due to a batcher restart. We're issuing provisional credit and will follow up with a postmortem and permanent fix." :white_check_mark:
Jordan Lee: Short term mitigation: enable strict idempotency check in batcher and add pre-deploy drain hook. Patching now.
Support Ops Bot: Patch rollout started: batcher-service v2.15.1 -> enforces idempotency header and soft-drain.
Liam Patel: Added a reconciliation job to backfill and mark duplicates as deduped. Script:
```
# pseudo
for ev in duplicates:
  mark_as_deduped(ev.id)
  create_offset_event(ev.customer_id, -ev.token_count, meta='dedupe backfill')
```
Emma Carter: Can we do the provisional credit first and then confirm after backfill? Customer asked for fast resolution.
Sophie Nguyen: Yes finance prefers provisional credit now. Put exact USD amount in refund reason and include revrec tag: "dup_rollup_2026-02-18". I'll follow up with accounting for G/L entries.
Jordan Lee: I'll attach reconciliation outputs to INC-4567 once job finishes (ETA 2h).
Billing Bot: PROVISIONAL CREDIT created: credit_id=CR-87721 customer=acme-health amount_tokens=4320 reason="dup_rollup_2026-02-18" initiated_by=Emma Carter
Emma Carter: Notified customer with credit id and timeframe. They responded: "Thank you — appreciate the quick fix. Please send final transaction when resolved." :pray:
Sophie Nguyen: After backfill we need a final accounting note for revenue recognition: include original invoice id, credit id, root cause summary, and net effect. I'll draft the revrec note.
Liam Patel: Postmortem action items: 1) require idempotency header on all webhooks 2) add deploy drain hook for batcher 3) nightly reconciliation alert if delta > 1% 4) run backfill immediately after patch.
Jordan Lee: Created follow-up PRs and a runbook for support: steps to validate and escalate to finance.
Support Ops Bot: Reconciliation job completed: duplicates resolved, net tokens adjusted = -4320, job_id=RJ-4421.
Jordan Lee: Attaching reconciliation CSV to INC-4567 (private).
Sophie Nguyen: Drafted revrec note and emailed accounting. Will mark case as "pending-finalization" until finance posts final journal entry.
Emma Carter: Closing loop with customer: "Finalized — we applied provisional credit CR-87721 and reconciled ledger; your invoice was adjusted. Let us know if anything else." :tada:
Sophie Nguyen: I'll close accounting ticket once GL entries are posted. Thanks team.
Liam Patel: Filing a short postmortem in /eng-postmortems and adding labels: "billing-impact", "deploy-hardening".
Emma Carter: Great. Filing internal incident: INC-4567 -> postmortem link added.
Billing Bot: NOTE: This thread resulted in 1 provisional credit and 1 ledger backfill. Audit trail: CR-87721, RJ-4421, INC-4567."
